in_sanskrit.name: कवियारसन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the taste or understanding of a poet or scholar

in_hindi.name: कवियारसन
in_hindi.meaning: कवि (poet, scholar) + रसन (अधिकारी, one in charge of something, in this case, understanding or taste)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is in charge of understanding or taste, like a poet or scholar

in_tamil.name: கவியாரசன
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses the knowledge or understanding of a poet

in_telugu.name: కవియారశె౱న
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the taste or understanding of a poet

in_marathi.name: Kaviyarasan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaviyarasan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kaviyarasan is derived from the Tamil words ‘Kavi’, meaning learned or scholar, and ‘Yarasan’, meaning lord or master. In Hindu mythology, Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Skanda, is considered the patron deity of learning, knowledge, and wisdom.

In Hindu mythology, Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Skanda, is considered the patron deity of learning, knowledge, and wisdom.
